name: Price Alerts for WooCommerce
author: Devnet

sections.description:
Price Alerts for WooCommerce lets your customers subscribe to product price drops and get notified when the price falls below their chosen target. Ideal for stores that want to boost conversions on high-interest items, this plugin offers a smooth subscription experience, supports both simple and variable products, and lets you control exactly when and to whom price drop emails are sent — all from your WordPress dashboard.

Set it up in minutes, customize to fit your theme, and start growing your list of interested buyers.

Who Is This Plugin For?

Price Alerts for WooCommerce is built for:

  • 🛒 Store Owners — who want to convert window shoppers into customers with automated price-drop alerts.
  • 🧰 Agencies & Freelancers — delivering value-added features to clients without extra development time.
  • 📈 Growth-Focused Shops — looking to re-engage visitors, recover lost sales, and improve conversions effortlessly.
  • ✨ UX Enthusiasts — aiming to enhance customer experience with non-intrusive, on-page functionality.
  • ⚙️ WooCommerce Power Users — who want more control, more automation, and more sales without complex setups.

If you’re running a WooCommerce store and want to make more sales from the traffic you’re already getting—this plugin is for you.

DOCUMENTATION

Features

  • Customers can subscribe to price alerts directly on product pages
  • Works seamlessly with both simple and variable products
  • AJAX-enabled frontend for smooth, no-reload interactions
  • You decide who gets notified and when — send Price Drop emails manually from the dashboard
  • Fully translatable and developer-friendly for customization

Early Development Notice

Price Alerts is in the early stages of development, and we’re actively working to expand its features. Future updates will include support for additional features and deeper integrations.

Your feedback is invaluable! If you have specific needs or suggestions, please share them in the support forum. We appreciate your support and look forward to improving Price Alerts with your input.

Support

We’re here to help. Feel free to open a new thread on the Support Forum.

Documentation

You can check Price Alerts documentation here.

Reviews

It’s funny how much joy all those 5-star reviews bring to our team. It really keeps us going and motivates us to bring more cool features.
If you like this plugin, feel free to leave a review.

Other Plugins by Devnet

Here are some other plugins we have developed that you might find useful:

  • Free Shipping Label – Increase order revenue by showing your customers just how close they are to your free shipping threshold.
  • Product Price History – Track product price history with customizable charts and graphs on your WooCommerce store. Show lowest price and increase customer trust.
  • Easy Subscribe – Effortlessly integrate customizable subscription forms on your WordPress site with a simple shortcode.
  • Easy Booking Calendar – Turn any product into a reservation-ready item. This plugin adds a customizable calendar to product pages, allowing customers to select date ranges for bookings.
  • BizNotes – Exclusive admin notes for seamless order management among multiple admins. Effortless collaboration, powered up.
  • Snap Blocks – A lightweight plugin that lets you create reusable content blocks in WordPress.
  • PingVid – A lightweight WordPress plugin that adds a floating video widget to your site.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Price Alerts.
  3. Install and activate the Price Alerts plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire price-alerts folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the Price Alerts plugin.

After activation

Visit the new Price Alerts > Settings menu.
Setup the plugin and enable the form.
